messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['Depending on your current storage space you may request for additional storage.', 'IF YOU NO LONGER WISH TO BE MEMBER OF AOL SERVICE, SIMPLY IGNORE THIS E-MAIL AND CANCELLATION WILL ACCUSE AFTER 1 HOUR FROM READING THIS E-MAIL.', 'Kindly upgrade your account to Increase Capacity to 25\xa0GB to view emails', 'Registering Warren DES Linkages', 'If this sign up was made by the third person, and you want to cancel the subscription, click the link under the sign-up specifications in this message, and then change the password on your Apple account, possibly it was stolen.', 'Due to this, to ensure that your service is not interrupted, we request you to confirm ...', 'As the Primary Contact, you must renew the service(s) listed below.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
